title: pollen-robotics/microduck_rl: train locomotion policies for an open robot duck
friendlyTitle: microduck_rl teaches an open robot duck how to move
summary: microduck_rl provides reinforcement-learning environments, reward definitions, tests and ONNX export tooling for Pollen Robotics’ Microduck. It supports training and hot-swapping locomotion policies in simulation before deploying them to the physical robot.
friendlySummary: This project contains simulated training environments and tools for creating movement policies for the Microduck robot.
whyItMatters: Robotics learners and researchers can inspect a concrete simulation-to-robot workflow, experiment with rewards and train movement policies without starting from an empty environment. Physical deployment still requires careful testing because simulation does not capture every real-world failure.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is a practical way to learn how robot training moves from simulation to real hardware, with testing before the robot acts.
